breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth removed the contradictory instruction to use a thin-walled tube approximation. The agent, however, kept the contradictory instruction: "Model the hollow circular shaft as a thin-walled closed tube. Use the mean-area shear-flow relation to determine surface stress and twist." This repeats the original error instead of correcting it.
